title: Types of computer by size, storage and speed
competency: Classify computers by size, storage and speed.

keywords.def: A small general-purpose computer, also called a personal computer (PC).
A computer larger and more powerful than a microcomputer but smaller than a mainframe.
A large, powerful computer used by many users at once, e.g. by banks and airlines.
The fastest and most powerful type of computer, processing trillions of instructions per second.

en.text: By size, storage and speed there are four types. Microcomputers (PCs) are small and the most widely used: desktops, laptops, notebooks and tablets. Minicomputers are bigger and more powerful than micros. Mainframes are large, serve many users at once and process millions of instructions per second, used by banks and airlines. Supercomputers are the fastest, processing trillions of instructions per second, used for weather forecasting and research.

screens.title: Forecasting the weather
screens.ask: The national weather agency needs to calculate tomorrow's weather from millions of measurements. Which computer suits it best?
screens.after: Supercomputers process trillions of instructions per second; weather forecasting is a typical use.

screens.title: Kinds of PCs
paras: Desktops: the case sits on a desk; some all-in-one desktops join the system unit and monitor.
Portables can be carried: laptops, notebooks and tablets.
A tablet is a portable PC with a touch screen, smaller than a notebook but larger than a smartphone.
A smartphone combines a mobile telephone and computing functions in one unit.
